subject: Logic
title: Decision Fatigue
description: A fast breakdown of Decision Fatigue for builders.

hook.text: Judges grant parole 65% of the time in the morning but nearly 0% right before lunch. Hunger decided freedom.

buildup.text: Decision fatigue: the quality of your decisions deteriorates after making many choices in a row.

discovery.text: Your brain treats willpower and decision-making as a depletable resource—like a muscle that tires.

twist.text: This is why Steve Jobs wore the same outfit daily—he eliminated trivial decisions to save energy for important ones.

climax.text: Make important decisions early. Automate the trivial ones. Protect your mental bandwidth for what matters.

quiz.question: What causes decision fatigue?
options: Mental energy depleting after many decisions
